rules.body: 🛡️ Bot rules • This bot is for adults aged 18 and over. • Interactions require freely given consent. Consent can be withdrawn; respect boundaries, refusals and requests to stop. • Threats, blackmail, scams, harassment and pressure to continue are prohibited. Roleplay does not permit real abuse. • Do not publish another person’s private information, images or messages without permission, or pressure them to share identifying details. • Phone numbers, links, Telegram IDs, forwarded messages, user advertisements and spam are not allowed in partner chats. Use only the bot’s approved information-exchange flow. • Report an unsafe chat to leave it. Support is available for account and payment problems. • The preference test is optional. Its results are private descriptions, not a diagnosis. Connection rules Anonymous chat • {normal_coins} coins per person, charged once when matched. Waiting is free. • Maximum {normal_seconds} seconds. No extensions or extra charges. Either person may leave early without a refund. {miss_title} & {mister_title} • First {initial_minutes} minutes: {initial_coins} coins. Then {interval_coins} coin(s) per {interval_minutes} minutes, charged at the start of each block. • Users may leave anytime; voluntary exits are not refunded. • Providers may leave after {provider_leave_minutes} minutes. Leaving before minute {initial_minutes} returns {early_refund_coins} coins to the user; later exits have no refund. • {unanswered_limit} unanswered messages and {response_seconds} seconds without a reply end the connection. Even one unanswered message ends it after {silence_seconds} seconds of silence. Unused time is refunded, rounded up to whole coins. • Repeated missed replies suspend provider availability. Insufficient balance ends the connection. Safety & refunds • Report an unsafe conversation to leave immediately, including during a provider minimum period. • Delivery failures return unused paid time. Refunds are bot coins, not Telegram Stars. • Support is available from every panel. Special chats require provider approval before billing begins. Information exchange: {info_exchange_coins} coins after approval; both parties share Telegram identity and province/city, using the provider’s MM profile. Phones are excluded. Text and captions are stored privately and are unavailable in staff panels. 🎁 Free coins & anonymous links Welcome credit is once per Telegram account. Referral rewards are once per eligible invitee, after adult eligibility and profile completion. Self-referrals do not count. Anonymous link messages and replies are free; the same consent, age and content rules apply.

guide.normal.0: 💬 Guide / Connections Anonymous chat Review the price, then search. Each person pays {normal_coins} coins when matched, for up to {normal_seconds} seconds. Waiting and cancelling the search are free. There are no extensions. Either person can leave early without a refund. {miss_title} & {mister_title} Choose an online profile, read their bio and interests, and review the rules. The initial {initial_minutes} minutes cost {initial_coins} coins, then each {interval_minutes}-minute block costs {interval_coins} coin(s). Only one connection can be active per account. Use the Status and End connection controls during a chat.
guide.normal.1: 💬 Guide / Profile & wallet Your profile Use a display name you’re comfortable sharing. Add a short bio and write your interests in your own words, up to 300 characters. Send the text to save it; use Cancel to keep your current text or Clear interests to remove it. These details help your partner understand what you enjoy. Your wallet Open Wallet to buy coins with Telegram Stars. The standard offer is {stars_pack} Stars for {coins_pack} coins. If enabled, the test offer is {test_stars} Stars for {test_coins} coins. Coins are credited after Telegram confirms payment. Wallet history lists each charge, grant, purchase and refund. Change English/فارسی in Options. /start always opens this normal panel. Complete your name and gender first. Gender can be changed twice. Phone verification is optional and accepts only your own Telegram contact. Select province before city; changing province clears city. Welcome setup requires province and city. The preference test is optional and remains on the main menu. Find providers in Online roles, and settings, guide, support and rules in Features & settings. Controls are below the text box. 🎁 First /start: 10 welcome coins. In Free coins, completed profiles can get an invite link; the last valid link opened before a friend completes setup earns both sides 10 coins. 🔗 Share your Anonymous link for free private messages. Senders need age eligibility and any required membership, but no completed profile. Rotate the link, reply, block or report from your inbox. 🎂 Setup now starts with age selection (12–50) and a confirmation before adult agreement. Ages under 18 cannot use the bot. The age step, name, gender, province and city are shown as short progress cards; the test stays optional.
guide.normal.2: 💬 Guide / Privacy & safety Your Telegram ID and username are hidden from partners. Display names and profile details can be shown, so avoid identifying information. Administrators can inspect accounts for support and moderation. Phone numbers, usernames/IDs, links, contact cards and forwarded messages are blocked according to the bot’s safety settings. This applies to text and media captions. Use Report & leave for an unsafe conversation. It ends the connection immediately. Coin refunds return to your bot wallet; they do not reverse a Telegram Stars payment. Activity indicators appear while messages are being delivered. Tap the compact reaction control under a received message to react. For account or payment help, open Support: @{support_username}. Special chats start after provider approval. Information exchange costs {info_exchange_coins} coins on approval and shares only Telegram identity and province/city. Chat controls stay in your keyboard until the chat ends. Reply with an emoji to react. Preference test: choose Quick (36 questions) or Full (54). Retake anytime with no queue. Each attempt has its own timer. Results stay private in your profile and never appear to MM or staff panels.
guide.mm.0: ✨ Provider guide / Getting ready /mm opens your separate Miss & Mister panel. A superadmin assigns this role; provider accounts cannot join normal matching or book another provider. Add your MM display name and bio, then write your interests in up to 300 characters. Your MM interests are separate from your personal interests. Send your text to save it, or use Cancel or Clear interests. Go online when ready to receive a connection. While waiting, use the waiting refresh before {online_seconds} seconds pass. Any interaction refreshes your heartbeat. Going offline removes you from the available directory. After a connection ends, go online again when you’re ready. Your partner’s interests appear when you connect.
guide.mm.1: ✨ Provider guide / Replying & leaving The user pays {initial_coins} coins for the first {initial_minutes} minutes, then {interval_coins} coin(s) per {interval_minutes} minutes. You are not charged for receiving a user. Reply to the user’s messages. If {unanswered_limit} messages remain unanswered for {response_seconds} seconds, or even one remains unanswered for {silence_seconds} seconds, the connection ends and unused time is refunded. This adds a response strike; {strike_limit} strikes suspend online availability pending review. Reactions do not count as replies. You may leave voluntarily after {provider_leave_minutes} minutes. Leaving before minute {initial_minutes} returns {early_refund_coins} coins to the user; later voluntary exits return nothing. The user can leave anytime without a refund. Review a customer’s name, interests before accepting their request. Your MM name, bio, interests and location are separate from your personal profile. Fill in MM location before going online if you want to approve information exchanges.
guide.mm.2: ✨ Provider guide / Safety & support No contact details, links or forwarded messages. These rules apply to both partners. For an unsafe conversation, use Report & leave immediately—even before the minimum voluntary exit time. A provider safety exit returns the user’s unused time and creates a report for review. A missed-response strike can be reviewed and reset by a superadmin. Reinstatement does not automatically make you available: go online only when ready to respond. Options contains language, wallet history and connection history. The Status screen shows elapsed and remaining paid time. For help, open Support: @{support_username}.
guide.admin.0: 🛠️ Admin guide / People & coins /admin opens your management panel independently of /start. Open People, filter by role or search by Telegram ID/display name. Select an account to inspect its balance, connection status and response strikes. Histories open on separate paginated pages. Choose Give coins, select a preset or send a custom whole-number amount, then review the recipient and resulting balance. Coins are credited only after Confirm. Repeated confirmation cannot credit the same grant twice. Admins can inspect accounts and give coins. Global settings, roles, bans/unbans and strike resets are reserved for superadmins. Advertisements, broadcasts and required-channel membership are available in the admin panel. Compose using Telegram formatting and one attachment, add link buttons and preview before publishing.
guide.admin.1: 🛠️ Admin guide / Safety review Blocked content lists the account, time and reason for a moderation block. The prohibited message body is not stored in this log. Safety reports list requests to end unsafe conversations. Use Inspect account to review the relevant wallet and connections. Reports are evidence for review, not an automatic ban. A superadmin decides account restrictions and reinstatement. Avoid changing a wallet just to hide a dispute: review its ledger, the agreed session terms and any recorded refund. Support is available at @{support_username}.
guide.admin.2: 🛠️ Admin guide / Reading histories Wallet history shows coin grants, Stars purchases, connection charges and coin refunds. Each entry has an amount, reason and UTC timestamp. Connection history shows the account’s own charge/refund, status and end reason. Anonymous chat charges {normal_coins} coins per person once and lasts at most {normal_seconds} seconds. Providers are not charged for receiving paid users. A bot coin refund is not a reversal of Telegram Stars. Refer payment disputes to Support. Use Options to change the panel language. /start returns to the anonymous chat panel without changing your access. Conversation text is stored privately and cannot be viewed or exported through staff panels.
guide.superadmin.0: 🛠️ Superadmin guide / Account access /superadmin opens the owner controls. Open People, select an account and choose Change role, Give coins, Edit profile or Reset response strikes. Ban ends a connection and removes the account from matching while preserving its wallet and profile. Unban restores the saved previous role; a provider remains offline until ready. Always review the account before confirming. Protected superadmins cannot be banned or demoted here. Roles are User, Miss, Mister, Admin and Superadmin. A role change requires the account’s current connection to end first. Each role opens its own command panel. Use histories and the activity log to review changes.
guide.superadmin.1: 🛠️ Superadmin guide / Profiles & appearance Interests is a free-text field limited to 300 characters, edited in each person’s profile. Selectable catalogs and the separate Preferences field have been removed. MM interests remain separate from personal interests. Appearance & support contains bilingual bot/provider titles, welcome text, support text and the Telegram support username. Custom text is displayed as plain text.
guide.superadmin.2: 🛠️ Superadmin guide / Behavior settings Anonymous chat controls price per person, fixed duration, availability and search timeout. Provider sessions control initial/extension price and time, earliest provider exit, early refund and online heartbeat. Safety controls response deadlines, strikes and contact/forward blocks. Payments controls both Stars packages and the test offer switch. Choose a setting, use a preset or custom value, then review and confirm. Invalid combinations are rejected: refunds cannot exceed initial cost, exit time cannot exceed the initial period, and the silence deadline cannot be shorter than the response deadline. Changes affect new sessions and offers. Active sessions and issued invoices keep their agreed prices. These controls edit the bot’s implemented behavior; new features require a code change. Support: @{support_username}. Conversation text is stored privately and cannot be viewed or exported through staff panels.

quiz.how: 🧭 About this original test Each area has three original items, including a reverse-worded item. Ratings run from −3 to +3. We map them to 0–100, reverse marked items, then calculate a weighted mean for each area. Skipped items are excluded; at least two answers are needed per area. Neutral ratings sit at the midpoint. Scores describe your responses, not a probability, diagnosis or proof of compatibility. Questions and scoring are versioned. Completed results keep the version used when you took the test. No external test bot receives your answers.
